thread:
Alice M.: Quick question — contractor (contractor@example.com) needs read access to runtime logs for project `realtime-infer`. No access to secrets or config. Do I give them `project.viewer` or a custom `console-logs-reader`? Any redaction/policy gotchas?

Ben K.: Prefer custom role scoped to the project with only logging read perms. `project.viewer` is too broad (lists, metadata, some configs).

Ben K.: Example quick grant (GCP-style) — scope to project and use a role like `roles/logging.viewer` or our internal `redwood.consoleLogsReader`:

```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding realtime-infer \
  --member=user:contractor@example.com \
  --role=roles/logging.viewer
```

Carla (sec): +1 on least-privilege. Two notes: 1) Ensure logs are redacted at ingestion for PII (we have processors that should strip tokens/email). 2) Avoid giving `storage` or `secretmanager` access.

Dinesh: Also consider time-limited access: create a short-lived binding via our access-request flow (OKTA/JIT) so contractor access auto-expires.

Maya S.: If they only need to view logs in Console UI, our `redwood.consoleLogsReader` is better than raw `roles/logging.viewer` because it also denies access to certain debug endpoints and mask some fields. Ask infra to attach the role to the project and add a condition: `request.time < timestamp("2024-04-01T00:00:00Z")` or use the access request ticket.

Alice M.: Nice. How do I confirm logs are redacted? I remember an audit item where a token leaked into logs.

Carla (sec): Run a sample query over recent logs, filter on `trace` and `request_body` fields, search for `token=` or email patterns. We also have a redaction test job: `infra/check-log-redaction` in CI. If it fails, don't grant access until fix.

sec-bot: POLICY SCAN: user contractor@example.com currently has roles: [project.viewer] in project realtime-infer — flagged (excess privileges). Recommendation: replace with roles/logging.viewer OR custom redwood.consoleLogsReader and add time-bound condition.

Alice M.: Thanks — I'll remove the project.viewer binding and open a JIT access request. Will run the redaction CI and paste results here. :thumbsup:

Ben K.: If you want I can do the IAM change with you. Ping me when you create the ticket.

Alice M.: Will do. Creating ticket now: ACCESS-1387.

Maya S.: For the ticket, include the principal, exact role (or custom role link), project id, and expiration. That speeds approvals.

Alice M.: Thanks all — closing once the change is applied and redaction check passes.
